rationale: CPU selection from measured parameter-gradient Grams only. Geometry uses shape=1 and cross-batch median raw-norm ratios for logsigma:relative-centroid:shape approximately 2:1:1; centroid uses eligible multi-part batches only. The common multiplier uses each batch's actual Gram composite, targeting geometry/Head=1 for IA or J/density=0.5 for IB. IB targets occupancy-BCE/density=1 and leaves Dice disabled. These are conservative starting policies, not demonstrated optimal weights or evidence of training benefit.

policy.bound_interpretation: numerical stop bound, not an optimum range
